from grades import load_grades, ROWS
from ledger import GradeLedger


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_grades())
    ledger = GradeLedger(rows[:1])
    ledger.add(rows[1])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_copy_is_safe():
    rows = list(load_grades())
    ledger = GradeLedger(rows[:2])
    ledger.grades().append(rows[2])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]

from grades import load_grades, ROWS
from ledger import GradeLedger


def test_total_after_add():
    rows = list(load_grades())
    ledger = GradeLedger(rows[:1])
    ledger.add(rows[1])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_add_to_empty():
    rows = list(load_grades())
    ledger = GradeLedger()
    for x in rows:
        ledger.add(x)
    assert ledger.total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS) and len(ledger.grades()) == len(ROWS)


def test_copy_is_safe():
    rows = list(load_grades())
    ledger = GradeLedger(rows[:2])
    ledger.grades().append(rows[2])
    assert ledger.total() == ROWS[0][1] + ROWS[1][1]


def test_initial_total():
    assert GradeLedger(load_grades()).total() == sum(v for _, v in ROWS)
